name: bregman_divergence_simplex_classical
divergence_log: Classical Bregman divergence D_phi(p||q) = phi(p) - phi(q) - <grad phi(q), p-q> is defined on a commutative simplex using a scalar potential phi. Quantum Bregman divergence requires an operator-convex trace functional and honors noncommutativity of rho, sigma via symmetric logarithmic derivatives. The classical substrate cannot distinguish states that share eigenvalues but differ in eigenbasis: quantum coherence between eigenbases is invisible here.
